 Print 'I Play Rocky' collects Rs 1 crore in gross collections in India. (Instagram) ‘I Play Rocky’ tells the tale of a young Sylvester Stallone starting in the industry and trying to make one of his most popular films, 'Rocky,' a reality when he had no credentials or impact. The film had special screenings in the US and the UK on November 6 and was internationally released in theatres only 3 days ago. Despite competition from other releases, the film has managed to cross the Rs 1 crore mark in gross collections in India. ‘I Play Rocky’ box office collection day 3
 According to Sacnilk data, ‘I Play Rocky’ collected Rs 37 lakhs on its third day of box office collection in India. This brings the overall net collection of the biographical film to Rs 99 lakhs, while the net gross collection came to around Rs 1.11 crore. The film’s numbers did surge over the weekend, though it was played across 217 screens, a relative drop compared to its opening day. On November 13, the film ran across 223 screens. ‘I Play Rocky’ worldwide collection 
 Beyond India’s box office collection for the film, Box Office Mojo shared that ‘I Play Rocky’ has collected over USD 1.7 million worldwide. The film has earned USD 954,138 so far in North America, following a weak opening of USD 337,465 in the region on day one. It has also collected USD 811,489 (GBP 6,516) in the UK. ‘I Play Rocky’ net box office collection
